🖱️ Creating Segments:
  • Left-click to navigate through the audio
  • Right-click + drag to create a segment
  • Or use [ and ] keys to mark start/end while playing
  • Drag segment edges to resize
⌨️ Keyboard Shortcuts:
  • Space - Play/Pause
  • [ ] - Mark segment start/end
  • Enter - Create segment from markers
  • Delete - Delete selected segment
  • +/-/0 - Zoom in/out/fit
  • ← → - Skip 5s (Shift: 30s)
📝 Quick Start:
  1. Select a label above
  2. Right-click and drag on waveform to create segment
  3. Adjust edges by dragging if needed
